description: GHOST KCK: a 909-style kick built from a struck resonator, with a pitch envelope, a filtered click and a saturation stage

params.text: Sets the pitch of the body
Sets how long the body rings
Sets how far the pitch envelope lifts the start of the note
Sets how quickly the pitch envelope falls back to the tuned pitch
Sets the level of the click at the front of the note
Sets how hard the whole kick is driven into saturation; noon is the calibrated setting, anticlockwise is cleaner and clockwise is crushed
Sets how tight the click is, from a long smeared attack to a sharp tick
Sets the brightness of the body

inputs.text: Fires the kick on a rise past 2V, and samples both accent jacks at that instant
Adds to the tune knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the pitch amount knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the pitch decay knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the click knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the drive knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the level knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the attack knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Adds to the tone knob, the whole knob range over 10V
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit while it is high at the moment of the trigger, as Accent B
Raises the level and the accent character of a hit while it is high at the moment of the trigger, as Accent A, shared by the whole kit

notes: the total accent jack reads as accented while nothing is patched into it, so a voice on its own sounds at its accented level until you patch an accent gate
the accent amounts and master level come from a GHOST CTRL touching this module, or reaching it along a row of touching Ghost modules; with no controller the voice runs at its own settings
an accent gate with no trigger at the same moment does nothing: the gates are read only at the instant the trigger fires
this is the one voice with an accent floor, so the RANGE switch on GHOST CTRL changes how far its unaccented hits drop below its accented ones
